title: Shopify content QA
summary: Checks a Shopify store's public pages each day for missing descriptions, alt text, broken links, placeholder text, SEO gaps and price slips, and tracks what changed. It never edits the store.

stages.title: Discover pages
stages.does: Reads the home page, the sitemap, the public products.json feed and each page on the store host, with a pause between requests; never-read and least recently read pages go first under the cap. STORE is store_url, PAGES max_pages, DELAY request_delay_ms, LINKS max_link_checks; in worker mode it fetches through your Worker.
stages.command: python3 lib/discover.py --store STORE --out pages.json --max-pages PAGES --delay-ms DELAY --max-link-checks LINKS --docs snapshot.json --producer shopify-content-qa

stages.title: Check content
stages.does: Applies the editable rule pack in lib/rules.json; WORDS is thin_description_words.
stages.command: python3 lib/qa_checks.py --pages pages.json --rules lib/rules.json --out issues.json --thin-words WORDS --restricted restricted.json

stages.title: Screenshots (worker mode)
stages.does: Queues captures on your own Worker and reads short-lived links; off unless max_screenshots is above 0.
stages.command: python3 lib/worker_shots.py --worker WORKER --issues issues.json --max SHOTS --out shots.json

stages.title: Look (direct mode, optional)
stages.does: May view a few pages with high issues through the browser connector and add a note to the Inbox; never changes an issue.

stages.title: Track changes
stages.does: Compares with stored pages and issues, honours decisions and builds records and the Inbox; CAP is max_inbox_per_run.
stages.command: python3 lib/track.py --pages pages.json --issues issues.json --docs snapshot.json --producer shopify-content-qa --max-inbox CAP --out run-part.json

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

connectors.label: Your store's public pages
connectors.purpose: Read the home page, sitemap, products.json feed, pages and product JSON on the store host.
connectors.connect: Add the store host to the environment's allowed domains. No login or key is used.

connectors.label: Your content QA Worker
connectors.purpose: Fetch store pages through your Worker in worker mode and read screenshot links and notes; queuing a capture changes nothing on the store.
connectors.connect: Deploy worker/ from the repository, then add its host to the allowed domains and its token as a network secret.

connectors.label: Cloudflare Browser
connectors.purpose: View a few pages as screenshots without deploying a Worker.
connectors.connect: Add the Cloudflare Browser MCP server as a connector.
